  WHY: An implementer following the plan's citation would search for `derive_check_name_key`, not find it, and waste time determining whether they need to create it or whether the plan's claim about "already fetches the PR" means something else. The plan's "0 new calls" claim is correct (the PR is already fetched by the time the code reaches the fork gate), but the function name is fabricated — it will mislead the implementer.
- Requirement: CLAUDE.md §18.E / unattended_system_instructions.md §20.E requires every orchestrator plan to surface the listed automation details in a dedicated section near the top.
  Expected change site: A dedicated `## Automation surface (CLAUDE.md §18.E)` or `## Organization & Wiring (§18.E)` section near the top of `docs/plans/move-checking-roles-to-claude-plan.md`, between Summary/Context and Goals.
  Evidence of absence: The plan's section list has no "## Automation surface" or equivalent near-top section. The §18 bullet at lines 136-139 inside Constraints is a one-line note, not a dedicated section, and omits the required information. PR comment id 5855125196 (entry[7]) explicitly claims this section was added as a proactive fix, but the committed file at head 40300d5 does not contain it. The commit 40300d5 message lists only the 5 reviewer findings as addressed, not the §18.E section.
  SEVERITY: MAJOR
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
- Requirement: CLAUDE.md §18.F requires a full registry entry for every new single-use or long-running script or supervisor, including Script path, Introduced in, Type, Removal trigger, Removal preflight checks, and Owner. The plan introduces three new long-running workflows (`claude_check_resume.yml`, `internal-claude-check-resume.yml`, `ai-claude-check-resume.yml`) plus two new scripts (`scripts/claude_check.py`, `scripts/llm_external_seam.sh`).
  Expected change site: The Automation surface section (absent) or the §18 Constraints bullet (lines 136-139) of `docs/plans/move-checking-roles-to-claude-plan.md`.
  Evidence of absence: The §18 bullet at lines 136-139 names only `claude_check_resume.yml` and "the internal wrapper" and gives only two fields (Type: `long-running`, Removal trigger: `permanent — review annually`). It omits: (a) the full Script path for each file; (b) the Introduced in field; (c) Removal preflight checks; (d) Owner; (e) the consumer wrapper `ai-claude-check-resume.yml`; (f) the two new scripts.
  SEVERITY: MAJOR
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
